systems.country_label: ABIS of the police technique et scientifique
systems.platform: Innovatrics multimodal ABIS (fingerprint, palm print, face), with a criminal case management module that links biometric evidence between crime scenes and prepares court exhibits
systems.owner: National Police of Guinea, police technique et scientifique; supplied by Innovatrics
systems.tiers: Conakry, at the only police department in the country trained to process prints; 7,500 paper fingerprint cards migrated and 5,000 new criminal record cards enrolled in one month

note: A vendor case study of a fingerprint identification system at the forensic police in Conakry; class identification, and its case management module handles biometric evidence, not the reports or case files a station takes, so no fact. The document carries no date of deployment.
